latest.t: Invest $25,000 in These 4 Dividend Stocks to Start Building Retirement Income
latest.d: Four companies with decades of dividend raises span healthcare, staples, energy and real estate, and one pays nearly triple the yield of the others. Which one carries the biggest paycheck, and what risk does each hide for new retirees?

latest.t: 4 High Yield Stocks That Have Never Missed a Dividend Payment
latest.d: Recessions, oil crashes, and a pandemic failed to interrupt the quarterly checks from four household-name payers. But an unbroken record is a lower bar than it sounds, so we stress-tested each one on cash flow and debt before trusting the next payment.

latest.t: What If the Fed Doubles the Rate Hike in December? These 5 Dividend Stocks Could Prosper
latest.d: Markets say a quarter-point hike is nearly certain, but a hot inflation print could change that fast. Five dividend payers, from banks to an oil giant to a toothpaste maker, each win in a different way if the Fed gets aggressive.

latest.t: How Boomers Can Turn $150,000 Into Passive Income With These 4 Energy Dividend Stocks
latest.d: Social Security rarely stretches as far as a paycheck did, and selling shares to cover bills drains the nest egg. Four pipeline and oil giants offer another route, though one of them carries a tax quirk that can trip up IRA holders.
